name: SAR Filing by MLRO — Data Model
description: New entities introduced by JRN-003. Two entities are created: SuspiciousActivityReport (the SAR itself, filed with the NCA) and SARInvestigationRecord (the internal investigation record that leads to the SAR decision). Both are owned by SVC-014 (KYC/AML Service), classified as auditor_only, and subject to 7-year WORM retention.

entities.name: SuspiciousActivityReport
entities.description: The formal SAR submitted (or prepared for submission) to the NCA UKFIU under POCA 2002 s338. Created when the MLRO makes a decision to file. Contains all NCA-required fields, the MLRO's decision rationale, the NCA acknowledgement reference, and the ongoing consent regime status. This is the legal record of the bank's discharge of its SAR obligation.
entities.retention: 7 years WORM from decision date (MLR 2017 Regulation 40 — bank policy extends statutory 5-year minimum)

fields.name: sar_id
fields.validation_rule: RFC 4122 UUID v4. System-generated. Immutable after creation.
fields.transparency_note: Internal identifier. Never surfaced to customer (PER-001). Never included in any customer-facing communication.

fields.name: customer_id
fields.validation_rule: Required. FK → Customer.customer_id (ENT-001). Immutable after creation.
fields.transparency_note: Links SAR to Customer record. Access restricted to MLRO only. Not surfaced in any API response outside MLRO case management.

fields.name: investigation_id
fields.validation_rule: Required. FK → SARInvestigationRecord.investigation_id (ENT-009). Immutable after creation.

fields.name: trigger_type
fields.validation_rule: Required. Enum: automated_event | staff_disclosure | mlro_investigation. Immutable after creation.

fields.name: trigger_event_ref
fields.validation_rule: Conditional. Required when trigger_type = automated_event. References the source event ID (e.g. EVT-006 SanctionsHitDetected) and event instance UUID. Format: '<event_id>:<event_instance_uuid>'. Null if trigger_type = staff_disclosure or mlro_investigation.

fields.name: mlro_decision
fields.validation_rule: Required. Enum: file_sar | file_defensive_sar. (Only present when MLRO decided to file — dismissed decisions remain only in SARInvestigationRecord.) Immutable after creation.

fields.name: mlro_decision_date
fields.validation_rule: Required. ISO 8601 (YYYY-MM-DD). The date the MLRO recorded their formal decision to file. Immutable. Used as the start of the 5-business-day SLA window.

fields.name: mlro_decision_rationale
fields.validation_rule: Required. Free text. Minimum 200 characters. Must document specific grounds for suspicion. No generic boilerplate language — NCA guidance requires intelligence-bearing content. WORM — immutable after sign-off.

fields.name: investigation_summary
fields.validation_rule: Required. Free text. Summary of MLRO's investigation findings used to populate the NCA SAR grounds of suspicion narrative. Minimum 100 characters.

fields.name: estimated_value_gbp
fields.validation_rule: Optional. Decimal to 2dp. Estimated monetary value of suspicious activity in GBP. Null if value cannot be quantified. Must be >= 0.

fields.name: typology_codes
fields.validation_rule: Required. At least one NCA SAR typology code. Values from NCA typology code list (maintained by SVC-014). Examples: ML01 (general money laundering), TF01 (terrorist financing), FRD01 (fraud-related).

fields.name: subject_type
fields.validation_rule: Required. Enum: individual | business. Immutable after creation.

fields.name: account_details
fields.validation_rule: Required if known. Array of account objects: { account_id (UUID, FK → Account ENT-004), sort_code (string, 6 digits), account_number (string, 8 digits), account_type (enum: current | savings | business) }. At least one account required if subject_type = individual and a bank account is involved.

fields.name: transaction_details
fields.validation_rule: Required if applicable. Array of transaction objects: { transaction_date (ISO 8601 date), amount_gbp (decimal, 2dp), direction (enum: credit | debit), counterparty_name (string), counterparty_account (string), narrative (string) }. Populated from transaction history reviewed during investigation.

fields.name: consent_requested
fields.validation_rule: Required. Default: false. Set to true if MLRO is seeking NCA consent to proceed with a specific transaction before the SAR decision is known (consent SAR under POCA 2002 s338).

fields.name: consent_transaction_ref
fields.validation_rule: Conditional. Required when consent_requested = true. References the specific transaction for which NCA consent is sought. Format: internal transaction ID.

fields.name: nca_reference
fields.validation_rule: Conditional. Populated by SVC-014 on receipt of NCA SAR Online acknowledgement. Format: NCA-assigned reference string (format defined by NCA SAR Online system). Immutable after creation. Null until SAR is submitted and acknowledged.

fields.name: filed_date
fields.validation_rule: Conditional. ISO 8601 UTC. Populated when SuspiciousActivityReport.status transitions to 'filed'. Immutable. Used for SLA compliance calculation (must be within 5 business days of mlro_decision_date).

fields.name: consent_status
fields.validation_rule: Conditional. Required when consent_requested = true. Enum: awaiting_nca_response | granted | refused | moratorium_active | moratorium_expired | not_applicable. Default: not_applicable when consent_requested = false.

fields.name: moratorium_expiry_date
fields.validation_rule: Conditional. Required when consent_status = moratorium_active. ISO 8601 (YYYY-MM-DD). Calculated as filed_date + 7 calendar days (NCA initial moratorium period). Extended if NCA issues a moratorium extension notice (up to 31 days per extension).

fields.name: status
fields.validation_rule: Required. Enum: draft | ready_for_submission | filed | closed. Transitions: draft → ready_for_submission (MLRO completes form and confirms tipping-off review); ready_for_submission → filed (NCA acknowledgement received); filed → closed (investigation record closed, all post-filing actions complete).

fields.name: sla_status
fields.validation_rule: System-computed. Enum: within_sla | warning (4 days elapsed) | breached (5+ business days elapsed with status != filed). Immutable once breached — cannot be reset.

fields.name: mlro_id
fields.validation_rule: Required. FK → Staff.staff_id for PER-052. Must reference a staff member with MLRO role assignment. Immutable after creation.

fields.name: created_at
fields.validation_rule: System-generated. ISO 8601 UTC. Immutable.

fields.name: updated_at
fields.validation_rule: System-generated. ISO 8601 UTC. Updated on any field mutation. WORM — all versions retained.

relationships.description: SuspiciousActivityReport belongs to one Customer via customer_id FK. A customer may be the subject of multiple SARs over time.
SuspiciousActivityReport is produced from one SARInvestigationRecord.

design_decisions.decision: SuspiciousActivityReport is a separate entity from SARInvestigationRecord. The SAR is the formal legal filing instrument; the SARInvestigationRecord is the internal working document. A dismissed investigation produces a SARInvestigationRecord but no SuspiciousActivityReport.
design_decisions.rationale: Keeps the legal record of NCA filing (with immutable NCA reference) separate from the internal investigation workpaper. Supports the scenario where an investigation is closed without filing — the SARInvestigationRecord records the dismissal rationale while no SAR entity is created. Aligns with NCA guidance that the SAR itself is a formal legal instrument.

design_decisions.decision: customer_id is stored in SuspiciousActivityReport as a direct FK to ENT-001. Subject identity data (name, DOB, address) is NOT duplicated into SuspiciousActivityReport — the NCA form is assembled at submission time by reading the Customer entity.
design_decisions.rationale: Avoids PII duplication across entities. Consistent with the Single Customer View principle established for ENT-001. If a customer's details change between investigation and filing, the SAR assembles the current data at submission time — MLRO confirms accuracy as part of the submission review.

entities.name: SARInvestigationRecord
entities.description: The internal MLRO investigation record that supports the SAR decision. Created when a suspicion trigger is received. Contains all evidence gathered by the MLRO, the documented decision rationale, and a full timeline of investigation steps. Exists for all investigations — whether the outcome is a filed SAR, a defensive SAR, or a dismissal. This is the MLRO's working document and the evidentiary foundation for the SAR (where filed).
entities.retention: 7 years WORM from decision date (MLR 2017 Regulation 40)

fields.name: investigation_id
fields.validation_rule: RFC 4122 UUID v4. System-generated. Immutable after creation.

fields.name: customer_id
fields.validation_rule: Required. FK → Customer.customer_id (ENT-001). Immutable after creation.

fields.name: trigger_type
fields.validation_rule: Required. Enum: automated_event | staff_disclosure | mlro_investigation. Immutable after creation.

fields.name: trigger_detail
fields.validation_rule: Required. Object containing: { trigger_source (string — event name or staff name), trigger_timestamp (ISO 8601 UTC), trigger_narrative (string — description of the suspicious activity as initially received), related_event_id (string, null if manual) }. Immutable after creation.

fields.name: assigned_to_mlro_id
fields.validation_rule: Required. FK → Staff.staff_id. References PER-052 or PER-053 (if delegated). Must reference a staff member with MLRO or Deputy MLRO role.

fields.name: evidence_items
fields.validation_rule: Required. Array of evidence objects: { evidence_id (UUID), evidence_type (enum: transaction_record | kyc_document | staff_note | adverse_media | prior_sar | external_intelligence | account_statement), description (string, min 20 chars), added_by_mlro_id (UUID), added_at (ISO 8601 UTC), document_ref (string, null if no document attachment) }. WORM — items can be added but not modified or deleted after addition. Each item is independently timestamped and attributed.

fields.name: transaction_refs
fields.validation_rule: Optional. Array of internal transaction IDs reviewed during the investigation. Referenced transactions must exist in SVC-001 transaction store. Used to maintain a clean cross-reference between investigation and underlying transaction data.

fields.name: kyc_assessment_ref
fields.validation_rule: Conditional. FK → KycAssessment.assessment_id (ENT-003). Links the investigation to the current KYC assessment record reviewed during investigation. Null if no KYC assessment exists (e.g. early-stage onboarding trigger).

fields.name: timeline
fields.validation_rule: System-maintained + MLRO-appended. Array of timeline entries: { entry_id (UUID), entry_type (enum: trigger_received | investigation_opened | evidence_added | mlro_note | decision_recorded | sar_submitted | consent_response_received | investigation_closed), description (string), recorded_by (UUID — staff_id or 'system'), recorded_at (ISO 8601 UTC) }. WORM — entries can be added but not modified or deleted.

fields.name: mlro_decision
fields.validation_rule: Required on decision. Enum: file_sar | file_defensive_sar | dismissed. Set when MLRO records formal decision in PH-154. Immutable after creation.

fields.name: mlro_decision_rationale
fields.validation_rule: Required when mlro_decision is set. Free text. Minimum 200 characters. Documents specific grounds for decision. Immutable after sign-off.

fields.name: mlro_decision_date
fields.validation_rule: Required when mlro_decision is set. ISO 8601 (YYYY-MM-DD). Immutable. Starts the 5-business-day SLA clock.

fields.name: sar_id
fields.validation_rule: Conditional. FK → SuspiciousActivityReport.sar_id (ENT-008). Populated when mlro_decision = file_sar or file_defensive_sar. Null when mlro_decision = dismissed.

fields.name: status
fields.validation_rule: Required. Enum: open | decision_pending | dismissed | sar_in_progress | closed. Transitions: open → decision_pending (evidence gathering complete); decision_pending → dismissed (mlro_decision = dismissed); decision_pending → sar_in_progress (mlro_decision = file or file_defensive); sar_in_progress → closed (SAR filed and post-filing actions complete).

fields.name: created_at
fields.validation_rule: System-generated. ISO 8601 UTC. Immutable.

fields.name: updated_at
fields.validation_rule: System-generated. ISO 8601 UTC. Updated on any field mutation. WORM — all versions retained.

fields.name: closed_at
fields.validation_rule: Conditional. ISO 8601 UTC. Populated when status = dismissed or closed. Immutable after creation.

relationships.description: SARInvestigationRecord belongs to one Customer. A customer may be the subject of multiple investigation records over time.
SARInvestigationRecord produces zero or one SuspiciousActivityReport (zero if dismissed, one if filed).
SARInvestigationRecord optionally references one KycAssessment via kyc_assessment_ref.

design_decisions.decision: evidence_items and timeline are append-only WORM arrays within SARInvestigationRecord. No item may be deleted or modified after addition. Only new items may be appended.
design_decisions.rationale: MLRO investigation records must withstand judicial and regulatory scrutiny. Any modification or deletion of evidence items would undermine the evidentiary integrity of the record and potentially constitute perverting the course of justice. Append-only design is the only safe choice.

design_decisions.decision: SARInvestigationRecord exists for all investigation outcomes — including dismissed investigations. A separate SuspiciousActivityReport is created only when the MLRO decides to file.
design_decisions.rationale: MLR 2017 Regulation 40 requires records of all suspicious activity disclosures received — not just those that resulted in SAR filing. The MLRO must be able to demonstrate to the FCA that all internal disclosures were considered, even if dismissed. A dismissal record provides the audit trail of the MLRO's considered judgment.
